integrity: Proof and finite reproducibility script provided. The cited 2026 motivating article was accessible only at the abstract/metadata level; related later preprint and older quadrature literature were compared, but exhaustive historical priority was not established.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional operator-norm tensor trigonometric input class; sharp strict spectral gap has no explicit numerical lower estimate; cube-site comparison is deterministic worst case, and does not extend to all smooth-function classes.
title: The first interior-node obstruction for spectral quadrature on a tensor Veronese ball
